claims.claim: Malaysia has started repatriating around 5,000 asylum seekers from Myanmar under a deal with Min Aung Hlaing.
claims.episode_span: started repatriating around 5,000 asylum seekers from Myanmar under a deal with military ruler Min Aung Hlaing
claims.source_title: Malaysia begins controversial repatriation of asylum seekers to Myanmar
claims.supporting_quote: The Malaysian government has started repatriating around 5,000 asylum seekers from Myanmar, under a controversial deal agreed with Myanmar's military ruler Min Aung Hlaing.

claims.claim: Three Myanmar navy ships are scheduled to carry the first 1,476 returnees from Malaysia.
claims.episode_span: Three ships from the Myanmar navy are scheduled to carry the first 1,476 returnees.
claims.source_title: Malaysia begins controversial repatriation of asylum seekers to Myanmar
claims.supporting_quote: Three ships from the Myanmar navy are scheduled to leave Malaysia later today carrying the first 1,476 returnees.

claims.claim: Malaysia has described the repatriation as voluntary and has barred the UN refugee agency from seeing or screening the returnees, who have been kept in detention centres.
claims.episode_span: Malaysia has barred the UN refugee agency from seeing or screening people kept in detention centres
claims.source_title: Malaysia begins controversial repatriation of asylum seekers to Myanmar
claims.supporting_quote: Malaysia has described the repatriation as voluntary, but has barred the UN refugee agency from seeing or screening the returnees, who have been kept in detention centres.

claims.claim: Anwar Ibrahim says the returnees will include Rohingya and that he is responding to public hostility and has no choice but to negotiate their return.
claims.episode_span: He says he is responding to growing public hostility toward the large Rohingya population in Malaysia
claims.source_title: Malaysia begins controversial repatriation of asylum seekers to Myanmar
claims.supporting_quote: Anwar, whose popularity has fallen sharply this year, says he is responding to growing public hostility towards the large Rohingya population in Malaysia and has no choice but to negotiate with the Myanmar government over their return.

claims.claim: Human rights groups say returnees could face violence, persecution and forced conscription into the Myanmar army.
claims.episode_span: They say returnees could face violence, persecution and forced conscription into the Myanmar army.
claims.source_title: Malaysia begins controversial repatriation of asylum seekers to Myanmar
claims.supporting_quote: Human rights groups have condemned the repatriation, saying the returnees face violence, persecution and forced conscription into the Myanmar army.

claims.claim: South Korea's cabinet passed a special bill on nuclear-powered submarines to be submitted to the National Assembly, with aims to enact it this year, launch a lead ship in the mid-2030s and field one in the late 2030s.
claims.episode_span: South Korea's cabinet on Tuesday passed a special bill on introducing and operating nuclear-powered submarines
claims.source_title: Cabinet passes special bill on introduction, operation of nuclear-powered subs
claims.supporting_quote: The government has said it aims to enact the special law before the end of the year to launch the lead ship in the mid-2030s and field the homegrown nuclear-powered submarine in the late 2030s.

claims.claim: Wang Yi met Takeshi Iwaya in Beijing on Monday, warned that relations face a severe situation and are not normalised, and urged Japan to correct leadership statements on Taiwan.
claims.episode_span: Wang said bilateral relations face a severe situation and have yet to be normalised
claims.source_title: China warns Japan over WWII history as business delegation visits Beijing
claims.supporting_quote: During the talks, Wang warned that bilateral relations were facing a “severe situation” and had “yet to be normalised” ahead of next year’s 55th anniversary of diplomatic ties, according to a readout from the Chinese foreign ministry.

claims.claim: Ian Omar Chester, 44, pleaded guilty to one count of fraud and was sentenced to nine years with parole after three over almost $2.3 million.
claims.episode_span: sentenced to nine years in jail, with parole after three, over the misuse of almost $2.3 million
claims.source_title: Gold Coast developer jailed for misusing $2.3m in investor funds
claims.supporting_quote: He was sentenced to nine years in jail, with parole after three years.

claims.claim: South Korea's government and ruling Democratic Party agreed Tuesday to require public disclosure of unsolicited takeover offers by the end of the year.
claims.episode_span: agreed on Tuesday to require, by the end of this year, public disclosure of unsolicited takeover offers
claims.source_title: Gov't, ruling party agree to mandate public disclosure of unsolicited takeover bids
claims.supporting_quote: The government and the ruling Democratic Party (DP) agreed Tuesday to introduce the so-called bear hug system by the end of this year to revitalize the nation's capital market, requiring prospective corporate acquirers to publicly disclose details of unsolicited takeover offers.

claims.claim: An Indonesian Ombudsman inspection at Cibinong Prison in Bogor found apartment-like units officials said appeared to house inmates, equipped with televisions, a gym and fridges stocked with alcohol.
claims.episode_span: found apartment-like units just outside the main blocks that officials said appeared to house inmates
claims.source_title: Watch: Luxury units uncovered inside an Indonesian prison
claims.supporting_quote: A surprise inspection by the Indonesian Ombudsman at Cibinong Prison in Bogor, West Java, revealed apartment-like units located just outside the main detention blocks.

claims.claim: Sanjay Raut accused Maharashtra FDA officials of extortion and licence threats and demanded an inquiry by Commissioner Tukaram Mundhe.
claims.episode_span: Sanjay Raut wrote to Maharashtra FDA Commissioner Tukaram Mundhe accusing designated officers
claims.source_title: FDA officials extorting lakhs from eateries, quick-commerce firms, alleges Raut; seeks probe
claims.supporting_quote: Shiv Sena (UBT) leader Sanjay Raut on Monday (September 29, 2026) accused Maharashtra Food and Drugs Administration (FDA) officials of indulging in extortion and threatening hotels and quick-commerce businesses with licence suspensions, and demanded an independent inquiry against them.

claims.claim: OpenAI apologised for unauthorised June access by its models to Australian government websites, said patient records were not accessed, and Albanese called the incident unacceptable.
claims.episode_span: OpenAI has apologised after saying that, in June, during internal training, its models accessed Australian government websites
claims.source_title: OpenAI apologises for Australian government website hack by rogue AI agent, vows to ‘rebuild trust’
claims.supporting_quote: “In June, during internal training and evaluation our models accessed Australian government websites in ways they were not authorised to. We also should have handled our response better. We are sorry and working to do better in the future,” the ChatGPT maker said in a blog post.

claims.claim: Lee So-hee and Baek Hana beat Lin Shengshu and Tan Ning 2-1 to win Asian Games women's doubles gold, the first such South Korean title since 2002.
claims.episode_span: won women's doubles gold on Tuesday, beating China's Lin Shengshu and Tan Ning 2-1
claims.source_title: (LEAD) (Asiad) Lee So-hee, Baek Hana win women's doubles gold in badminton
claims.supporting_quote: Lee and Baek, world No. 2, took down the top-ranked team from China, Lin Shengshu and Tan Ning, by the score of 2-1 (26-28, 21-18, 21-18) at Ichinomiya City Municipal Gymnasium in Ichinomiya, just northwest of the main host city, Nagoya.
